actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Redraw the ENTIRE image as one complete clean anime/cel character illustration on white. ONE figure only. Keep reference 1's camera, face, hair, goggles, body proportions, clothing, hands, wrists, legs, footwear and whitespace unchanged in design. Reference 1's current knife endpoint positions are the defect and must be corrected.

Reference 2 is the accepted BACK of the SAME character and SAME fixed low-rear-waist shallow-X carry. It alone determines the weapons' locations relative to waist, relaxed hands and thighs. A camera moving around the vertical body axis changes left/right overlap and apparent blade width, but does not raise or lower the attached knife parts. Both pommels are almost level above the rear belt; both guard/root mounts are almost level on the rear belt. The ivory pointed tip is lower than the dark distal end. Do not slide one whole knife up or down to display it. The dark tip is hidden by a hand in reference 2, so there is no need to invent an exposed long end.

Reference 3 controls the actual distinct fantasy dagger shapes: broad angular dark fang and longer swept ivory blade; separate unique guards, red collars, blade-root red wedges and unique grips/pommels. True blade tips are tapered cutting edges with NO orange symbol. Orange marks belong only to the hidden/partly visible pommels. Nominal sizes remain dark .36 and ivory .42 of neutral hair-crown-to-barefoot height; never infer a new object length from foreshortened screen lengths.

Retain the original single black pants belt and rear leather root cradles/short collar bands. No side holsters, sheaths, thigh attachment or upper harness. RIGHT black full-finger glove/red wrist cuff/right thigh modules/short white sock; LEFT fingerless glove/orange terminal/long orange stocking. Clean deliberate cel blocks, no white blotches or cloudy hair. No extra panels, diagrams or captions.

Output FRONT only. Preserve the existing ivory tip at screen left beside the upper thigh, below the relaxed hand and shorts hem. Correct the dark knife at screen right: its distal end stays higher, in the anatomical LEFT hand's occluded region. It must NOT extend below that hand's fingertips or descend to the ivory tip's height. Prefer the dark point being hidden behind the relaxed fingers rather than forcing a visible entire blade. Any visible dark sliver has the true silver-edged blade contour, no orange-marked butt. Keep both hilts entirely behind torso/sleeves; no orange pommel at side waist. The crossed center remains hidden behind the shorts.
